rv.q: With a big heart and even bigger wigs, Drag: The Musical is a riotously fun show you’ll want to keep coming back to.
Drag: The Musical has everything you could want in a musical: heart, humor, big musical numbers, and characters you can’t help but root for.
The music shakes the house with beats that will have you forget these two hours have no intermission.

Alaska, on the other hand, is perfectly at home center stage. She holds court, acts as the gravitational center, and manages to give herself some A+ material–ballads, scenery chewing, and gowns galore–while also leaving a great deal of space for all the other drag performers to shine.

vr.q: go see drag the musical if you want to see drag Excellence if you want to just have a fun time if you want to have some drinks and just enjoy a campy evening
